newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Hasan said not buying Bre-X shares.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Hasan said not buying Bre-X shares.

text.p: Indonesian tycoon Muhammad "Bob" Hasan has not been buying shares in Canadian mining company Bre-X Minerals Ltd, which has a 45-percent stake in the Busang gold property, his spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
"He is not buying up Bre-X shares," Nia Sarinastiti of Hasan's Nusamba Group told Reuters.

Freeport McMoRan Copper and Gold Inc has a 15 percent stake in the Busang property in the province of East Kalimantan, the Indonesian government 10 percent and Nusamba and its two local partners the remaining 30 percent.
She also quashed speculation that Hasan, a close associate of President Suharto, was driving down Bre-X share prices so that he could mount a takeover bid for the company.

"No, no. He will not do something like that because it is a very high-risk event," she said, adding that Nusamba's participation in a joint venture to develop the Busang property would depend on the outcome of a feasiblity study.
"Nusamba's position has not changed," she said.
Sarinastiti also said that Hasan had sought a $120 million loan to finance a pulp mill his company PT Kiani Kertas was building in East Kalimantan.
"He is borrowing for another company (PT Kiani)...that is developing a pulp mill," she said. "He has been trying to fund the pulp factory he is building."
Hong Kong bankers said in early March that PT Kiani had mandated three banks -- Chiao Tung Bank, Korea Exchange Bank and Sumitomo Bank -- to arrange a $120 million loan facility.
She said speculation that Hasan was taking the loan to buy Bre-X shares was untrue.
Bre-X said last month the Busang property might hold less than the 71 million ounces of gold it had earlier declared. The original estimate would have made it the gold find of the century.

Industry sources said last week independent drilling tests of the Busang gold property are likely to be flown to Australia for analysis by mid-April with the results available by the end of the month.
